name: king-domfy-web-essentials
description: Projeto conceitual de streaming musical inspirado no Spotify.

scripts.create-dirs: mkdir -p dist/src/css && mkdir -p dist/src/js && mkdir -p dist/src/imagens && mkdir -p dist/src/media && mkdir -p dist/vendor && mkdir -p dist/pages
scripts.minify:js: uglifyjs src/js/app.js -o dist/src/js/app.min.js -c -m && uglifyjs src/js/player.js -o dist/src/js/player.min.js -c -m && uglifyjs src/js/template-loader.js -o dist/src/js/template-loader.min.js -c -m
scripts.build: npm-run-all clean create-dirs copy:assets minify:html minify:css minify:js clean:maps
